svg.title: O(log n) is a promise about a BALANCED tree
svg.desc: A whiteboard sketch showing seven values inserted in shuffled order forming a neat binary search tree of depth three, beside the same seven values inserted in ascending order forming a diagonal chain of depth seven with the word tree crossed out and replaced by linked list; measured bars showing depth 41 and 21.4 comparisons per lookup for shuffled insertion against depth 100,000 and 50,419 comparisons for sorted insertion, a factor of 2,356; and a B-Tree node drawn as a wide rectangle of about four hundred keys in one four-kilobyte page fanning out to three more, reaching a hundred million rows in three levels where a binary search tree needs twenty-seven.
svg.text: O(log n) is a promise about a BALANCED tree
the SAME 7 values, inserted in ORDER
